stages.name: intent_encode
stages.io: 384d consciousness → 384d audio intent (LayerNorm → SwiGLU → Linear + RoPE)

stages.name: audio_token_predict
stages.fn: AR transformer + 8-stage RVQ delayed pattern + CFG + KV-cache
stages.io: intent_emb cross-attention memory → 8 stages × 1024 vocab indices per frame, ctx 1536 frames

stages.name: vocode
stages.io: latent → 24kHz PCM (Vocos ISTFT or HiFi-GAN MRF)
